title: John Wick
description: A duotone John Wick poster built around a violet-and-crimson palette, using layered stills — a tense hallway confrontation, a candlelit standoff — unified by a shared color grade so the composite reads as one escalating scene rather than three cut-and-pasted images. The dripping gothic "Baba Yaga" lettering anchors the bottom third with real weight, playing off Wick's own nickname within the franchise, while the top-banner pull-quote in a contrasting serif gives the piece an editorial, lobby-card feel rather than a generic fan poster.
